value.loc: Convergence Properties; Pivotal Probabilities; Simulations, pp.5211-5215
value.quote: We define the general form of those pivotal probabilities, then derive efficient exact and approximated calculations
value.note: Main results: convergence/equilibrium proofs (EQ), simulations on synthetic data (SI), and algorithms for efficient pivotal probability computation with runtime analysis (AL: Algorithms 1-2, Proposition 9).

C1.reason: Algorithms 1 and 2, Proposition 9 and the runtime comparisons are algorithmic main results, so AL applies alongside EQ and SI.
